messages:
Priya: Quick heads-up 1: planning a terraform apply in the release quiet window tomorrow 03:30 UTC. Changes: VPC route adjustments, egress policy, and an IAM role trust update. Will be staged per-region. Any blockers? :wave:
Ben: No blockers from infra side. Suggest we take a full tfstate snapshot and record a revert plan before applying. Keep region canary to one region first.
Sasha: +1 to snapshot + canary. Also: please attach the plan link when ready and pin provider versions in the root module.
deploybot: change window reserved by @Priya for 2025-11-05 03:30 UTC no overlapping deploys allowed. Required checks: tf fmt, tf validate, plan approval.
infra-bot: terraform plan complete (detached) summary: additions=6, changes=4, deletions=0. Notable: route table updates for prod-vpc, iam role trust modifications for cross-account assume. plan: https://ci.internal/plans/789012
Priya: Proposed rollback criteria: 1) p95 latency >25% over baseline for 10m OR 2) errors spike >0.4% sustained 10m. If hit, trigger rollback script and notify oncall.
Ben: For provider pin, add to root module like:
```hcl
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 4.72"
    }
  }
}
```
Sasha: Also ensure modules using aws-sdk-compatible resources are tested against that provider range. I'll run module unit tests in CI.
Priya: Snapshot plan: infra-bot please create S3 tfstate snapshot and tag with release id. Also create a short revert apply plan and upload to the runbook.
infra-bot: snapshot created -> s3://redwood-backups/2025-11-05/release-20251105-tfstate-1771000000.tfstate.gz
Ben: I'll draft the revert plan: steps to apply previous state via `terraform init && terraform apply -target=...` plus a note to run `terraform state push` if we need to restore. Keep per-region apply window to 25m.
Sasha: I'll own canary validation. Smoke check script (basic) below:
```bash
# smoke.sh
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api.prod.example/health || exit 1
# assume-role smoke
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/test-assume --role-session-name smoke-test
```
Priya: Owners: Priya = release owner & runbook, Ben = snapshot + revert plan, Sasha = canary validation and smoke script, oncall = rollback executor.
Ben: Agree to 15m observation after canary apply. If metrics look good, proceed to remaining regions with 10m soak each.
Sasha: Adding release notes blurb: "IAM trust update to allow cross-account deployer; no customer-visible downtime expected, minor failover risk during route propagation." Link will be in release doc.
Priya: All set. I'll lock merges 30m before window and post final runbook (steps + links). :lock:
deploybot: Reminder scheduled 30m before window start.
Priya: Thanks team 1: will post final artifacts tonight.
